title: Main experiment - Session 2
body_text:
You will now start the Session 2 of the Main experiment. As a reminder, the structure of the experiment is described in the diagram below.


The structure of Session 2 is the same as Session 1. You must perform 2 tasks, answer a first survey about those tasks, then you must perform another 2 tasks and answer a second survey about those 2 latter tasks. Your actions will keep being recorded and your performance will keep counting towards your bonus remuneration.

Click on the button below to start Session 2
